allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: Aaron Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 10473239 securities pursuant to Bonus at its meeting held on August 26, 2025

allot.subject: Bonus
allot.text: Aaron Industries Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors at its meeting held on August 26, 2025, have considered and approved allotment of Bonus Equity Shares at the ratio of 1 : 1, i.e 1 Equity Shares for every 1 Equity Shares held.
